name: Site Emby
author: mistersuki@proton.me
description: Emby, a media server for films, series and music, watched in the browser or the Emby apps. It listens on the port of the site; the domain and HTTPS are set in the Website tab.
startup: if [ -f ./emby-start.sh ]; then bash ./emby-start.sh; else echo "Emby is not installed in this site: reinstall it from the Settings tab."; exit 1; fi

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Writes the start script of the site, then downloads the latest Emby with it (if that fails, the site does it when it
# starts). The media library and the settings (data/, media/) are kept when it is installed again: it is how Emby is
# updated.
cd /mnt/server
command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || { apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl ca-certificates >/dev/null; }
command -v dpkg-deb >/dev/null 2>&1 || { apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq dpkg >/dev/null; }

cat > /mnt/server/emby-start.sh <<'START'
#!/bin/bash
# Starts Emby on the port of the site. Its settings and library are in data/, put your films and series in media/.
# When Emby is not there yet (or "install" is given), it is downloaded first: the latest version of its GitHub releases.
ROOT="${EMBY_ROOT:-/home/container}"
cd "$ROOT" || exit 1
APP="$ROOT/emby/opt/emby-server"

install_emby() {
    case "$(uname -m)" in
        x86_64 | amd64) ARCH=amd64 ;;
        aarch64 | arm64) ARCH=arm64 ;;
        *) echo "Emby is only offered for x86_64 and arm64 machines."; return 1 ;;
    esac
    if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v dpkg-deb >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "curl and dpkg-deb are needed to download Emby."
        return 1
    fi
    # Downloaded into the folder of the site: /tmp is small (100 MB on Wings) and Emby weighs more than 200 MB.
    WORK="$ROOT/.emby-install"
    rm -rf "$WORK"
    mkdir -p "$WORK"
    export TMPDIR="$WORK"
    curl -fsSL -o "$WORK/release.json" https://api.github.com/repos/MediaBrowser/Emby.Releases/releases/latest || true
    URL=$(grep -o "https://[^\"]*emby-server-deb_[^\"]*_${ARCH}\.deb" "$WORK/release.json" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 || true)
    if [ -z "$URL" ]; then
        rm -rf "$WORK"
        echo "The latest version of Emby could not be found (GitHub did not answer). Try again in a few minutes."
        return 1
    fi
    echo "Downloading Emby: ${URL##*/} (100 to 250 MB, a few minutes)..."
    if ! curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$WORK/emby.deb" "$URL"; then
        rm -rf "$WORK"
        echo "The download of Emby failed: check that the site has at least 1 GB of disk free, then try again."
        return 1
    fi
    echo "Unpacking Emby..."
    rm -rf "$ROOT/emby"
    mkdir -p "$ROOT/emby"
    if ! dpkg-deb -x "$WORK/emby.deb" "$ROOT/emby"; then
        rm -rf "$WORK"
        echo "Emby could not be unpacked (is the disk full?)."
        return 1
    fi
    rm -rf "$WORK"
    echo "Emby is installed."
}

mkdir -p data/config media
if [ "$1" = "install" ]; then
    install_emby
    exit $?
fi
if [ ! -x "$APP/system/EmbyServer" ]; then
    echo "Emby is not in this site yet: it is downloaded now."
    install_emby || exit 1
fi

PORT="${SERVER_PORT:-8096}"
CONF=data/config/system.xml
if [ ! -f "$CONF" ]; then
    cat > "$CONF" <<XML
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<ServerConfiguration xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema">
  <HttpServerPortNumber>${PORT}</HttpServerPortNumber>
  <PublicPort>${PORT}</PublicPort>
  <EnableHttps>false</EnableHttps>
</ServerConfiguration>
XML
else
    sed -i -E "s#<HttpServerPortNumber>[0-9]+</HttpServerPortNumber>#<HttpServerPortNumber>${PORT}</HttpServerPortNumber>#; s#<PublicPort>[0-9]+</PublicPort>#<PublicPort>${PORT}</PublicPort>#" "$CONF"
fi
# The same environment as the launcher of the Emby package (opt/emby-server/bin/emby-server).
export AMDGPU_IDS_PATH="$APP/share/libdrm/amdgpu.ids"
export FONTCONFIG_PATH="$APP/etc/fonts"
export LIBVA_DRIVERS_PATH="$APP/lib/dri"
export OCL_ICD_VENDORS="$APP/etc/OpenCL/vendors"
export PATH="$APP/bin:$PATH"
export PCI_IDS_PATH="$APP/share/hwdata/pci.ids"
export SSL_CERT_FILE="$APP/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"
export VK_DRIVER_FILES="$APP/share/vulkan/icd.d"
export VK_LAYER_PATH="$APP/share/vulkan/explicit_layer.d"
export VK_IMPLICIT_LAYER_PATH="$APP/share/vulkan/implicit_layer.d"
export XDG_CACHE_HOME="$ROOT/data/cache"
export NEOReadDebugKeys=1
export OverrideGpuAddressSpace=48
if ! ldconfig -p 2>/dev/null | grep -q libicu; then export DOTNET_SYSTEM_GLOBALIZATION_INVARIANT=1; fi
echo "Emby starts on port ${PORT}: open the domain of the site to set it up."
cd "$APP" || exit 1
while true; do
    "$APP/system/EmbyServer" -programdata "$ROOT/data" -ffdetect "$APP/bin/ffdetect" -ffmpeg "$APP/bin/ffmpeg"         -ffprobe "$APP/bin/ffprobe" -restartexitcode 3
    code=$?
    # Exit code 3: Emby asked to restart itself (after an update of its settings).
    [ "$code" -eq 3 ] || exit "$code"
    echo "Emby restarts..."
done
START
chmod +x /mnt/server/emby-start.sh
mkdir -p /mnt/server/data /mnt/server/media
if EMBY_ROOT=/mnt/server bash /mnt/server/emby-start.sh install; then
    echo "Done: Emby is installed. Start the site, then open its domain."
else
    echo "Emby was not downloaded now: the site will download it when it starts."
fi
chown -R 988:988 /mnt/server 2>/dev/null || true
exit 0
